investigation_notes.Description: Anomalous activity detected: 850 files were downloaded from the Executive_Board_Confidential SharePoint site by Liam O'Sullivan at 2026-01-31T14:45:10Z from IP 194.126.101.99. The activity occurred at approximately 16:45 local time in Tallinn (business hours), but the user's role (Regional Logistics Coordinator, Supply Chain & Logistics) does not align with Executive/Finance file paths and the download volume (~170x their 24-hour baseline) combined with a WinHttpRequest-style user agent indicates scripted bulk access. There are no recent related events or similar alerts for this user, and because of the extreme volume and clear role-to-data mismatch this is classified as High Priority.
